1. (Currently Amended) A control system comprising: a processor; a memory coupled to the processor; and a controller comprising the processor and memory, wherein the controller is configured to be communicatively coupled to automation components in the control system and to facilitate performance of a process through interoperation with the automation components by generating a holistic state data structure, wherein the controller is configured to generate the holistic state data structure by: determining a model configured to describe the process used by the controller; determining input and output variables of the process; determining constraints on the input and output variables; determining an objective function associated with the process used by the controller; and storing the model, the input and output variables, the constraints, and the objective function in one of a plurality of fields in the holistic state data structure to enable the automation components to detect and operate with the controller upon receiving the holistic state data structure, wherein the holistic state data structure is transmitted to the automation components to facilitate real-time control operations and optimization of the process.

2. (Currently Amended) The control system of claim 1, wherein the controller is configured to be communicatively coupled to the automation components via a communication network and to communicate the holistic state data structure to each of the automation components upon connecting to the communication network, wherein the communication network comprises at least one of: a wired network, a wireless network, or a hybrid network.

3. (Currently Amended) The control system of claim 1, wherein the controller is configured to be communicatively coupled to the automation components via a backplane comprising electrical connections, and to communicate the holistic state data structure to the automation components upon connecting to the backplane.

4. (Currently Amended) The control system of claim 1, wherein the holistic state data structure is a standardized format understood by each of the automation components, wherein the standardized format comprises predefined field structures and data types specific to the control system.

5. (Currently Amended) The control system of claim 1, wherein the controller is configured to generate the holistic state data structure by: determining an intermediate search result of an optimization search; determining a state of the optimization search when the intermediate search result is determined; and storing the intermediate search result and the state in an optimization state field of the holistic state data structure.

6. (Currently Amended) The control system of claim 1, wherein the controller is configured to generate the holistic state data structure to facilitate performing an optimization search in conjunction with one or more of the automation components in the control system, wherein the optimization search comprises iterative refinement of control parameters.

7. (Currently Amended) The control system of claim 1, wherein the controller is configured to generate the holistic state data structure by: determining computational capabilities of the controller; determining interconnections with the automation components in the control system; and storing the computational capabilities and the interconnections in a controller settings field of the holistic state data structure.

8. (Currently Amended) The control system of claim 1, wherein the controller is configured to communicate the holistic state data structure to a server in the control system via a network connection to facilitate determining an optimization problem based on the holistic state data structure.

9. (Currently Amended) The control system of claim 1, wherein the controller comprises an in-memory database configured to store the holistic state data structure, wherein the in-memory database is implemented in the memory of the controller.

10. (Currently Amended) A tangible, non-transitory computer-readable medium configured to store instructions executable by a processor of a controller, wherein the instructions comprise instructions to: receive, using the processor, control system configuration data from a data source; determine, using the processor, automation components communicatively coupled to the controller and characteristics of the automation components based at least in part on the control system configuration data, wherein the characteristics include at least one of: operational models, computing capabilities, or communication protocols; determine, using the processor, an optimization problem based at least in part on the automation components and the characteristics of each of the automation components; and instruct, using the processor, one or more of the automation components to perform a control action in a process, wherein the control action is determined based at least in part on solving the optimization problem using the processor.

11. (Currently Amended) The computer-readable medium of claim 10, wherein the characteristics of each of the automation components comprise a model used by the automation component, wherein the instructions to determine the optimization problem comprise instructions to determine the optimization problem based at least in part on the model used by each of the automation components, wherein the model describes operational behavior of the automation component.

12. (Currently Amended) The computer-readable medium of claim 10, wherein the characteristics of each of the automation components comprise a computing capability of the automation component, wherein the instructions to determine the optimization problem comprise instructions to determine the optimization problem based at least in part on computing capabilities and compatibilities of each of the automation components.

13. (Currently Amended) The computer-readable medium of claim 10, wherein the control system configuration data comprises a plurality of holistic state data structures, wherein each of the plurality of holistic state data structures corresponds with one of the automation components and is received from the respective automation component.

14. (Currently Amended) The computer-readable medium of claim 13, wherein the instructions to determine the automation components and characteristics of the automation components comprise instructions to parse each of the plurality of holistic state data structures to extract the characteristics.

15. (Currently Amended) The computer-readable medium of claim 13, wherein each of the plurality of holistic state data structures comprises a standardized format with same fields, wherein the standardized format is predefined and consistent across all automation components.

16. (Currently Amended) The computer-readable medium of claim 10, wherein the instructions to receive the configuration data comprise instructions to receive the configuration data from a cloud-based server via a network connection.

17. (Currently Amended) A method for performing diagnostics on a control system comprising: determining, using a processor, holistic state data captured by a controller in the control system, wherein the holistic state data comprises model information, input and output variables, constraints, and objective functions; simulating, using the processor, operation of the controller based at least in part on the holistic state data while the controller performs other operations, wherein the simulating comprises executing the model and constraints in a simulation environment; analyzing, using the processor, the simulation of the controller to perform diagnostics on the controller, wherein the analyzing comprises comparing simulated results with actual system behavior; and adjusting, using the processor, operation of the control system based at least in part on the diagnostics.

18. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 17, wherein: simulating operation comprises simulating performance of various control actions by the controller using the model; and analyzing the simulation comprises analyzing results of the various control actions and comparing the results to expected outcomes.

19. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 17, wherein analyzing the simulation comprises: determining a predicted response to a control action determined by the controller using the model; and comparing the predicted response with an actual response to the control action to determine accuracy of the model.

20. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 19, comprising adjusting the model when the predicted response and the actual response vary by a threshold amount, wherein the adjusted model is stored in the controller for subsequent use.
